snippet.title: THE GROUNDSKEEPER | Official Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist THE GROUNDSKEEPER on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5223470/THE_GROUNDSKEEPER

Join the Discord Server: https://discord.gg/6xVCGDDsYg

THE GROUNDSKEEPER is a first-person simulation-horror game where you play as the solo caretaker of a haunted Victorian estate operated as a commercial tourist attraction. 

By night, scrub grime, blood, and supernatural filth with pressure washers and tools, evade hostile entities, capture photo evidence, and upload it to social media. By day, adjust ticket prices and monetize visiting tourists to fund equipment upgrades and keep the estate profitable.

Socials:

- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dtheprodev/

Press kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1t_akCDQ36zS52ZyOb7fmdMY6mzbiESvO?usp=sharing
